title: Wheat sowing down 15% so far; overall rabi crops coverage falls 11%
description:
Wheat - the main rabi crop - has been sown on 50.07 lakh hectare so far this year, down by 15.27 per cent from 59.10 lakh hectare a year ago, according to data released by the Union Agriculture Ministry.
The wheat crop is usually sown in October-November and harvested in March-April. In the 2025-26 crop year (July-June), wheat was planted on 336 lakh hectare.
As per the latest data, the pace of wheat sowing is lagging behind as compared to last year due to the 13 per cent deficient June-September monsoon, which reduced residual soil moisture before sowing began.
Experts said lower irrigation availability is another factor, with reservoir and canal water levels below normal in key wheat-growing states. Wheat requires several rounds of irrigation after planting.
